title: Tanzania or Kenya for Your Safari?
excerpt: Tanzania or Kenya for your first safari? Both are excellent. The differences in parks, crowds and combinations.
body:
## Tanzania

- The Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire.
- Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar.
- Large parks and lots of space.
- The migration most of the year.

## Kenya

- The Masai Mara and private conservancies.
- Amboseli with views of Kilimanjaro.
- Samburu, Laikipia and the coast.
- Short distances from Nairobi.

## Crowds

Tanzania's parks are larger. Kenya's conservancies limit vehicles.

## Combinations

Tanzania: mountain, safari and beach. Kenya: safari and coast.

## Both

See [combining Tanzania and Kenya](/blog/tanzania-and-kenya-combined/).

## Our view

We focus on Tanzania because we know it best through our partner. [Plan your Tanzania trip](/travel-proposal/).
